neighbours.label: a conjunction right after a stranded preposition or verb particle ('by or about', 'to and from', 'draws on and extends')
fire: Letters to or from the mayor are kept in the archive.
The study draws on and updates earlier surveys.
Articles by or about Darwin fill the library.
She commutes to and from the city by train.
Prices rose despite, or perhaps thanks to, the new tax.
He relied on and trusted his closest advisers.
The policy applies to and protects all tenants.
The weeks leading up to and through the election were tense.
quiet: Letters or parcels from the mayor are kept in the archive.
The study compares surveys and censuses from earlier years.
Articles and letters about Darwin fill the library.
She commutes by train and bus to the city.
Prices and taxes rose sharply last year.
He trusted and liked his closest advisers.
The policy protects tenants and landlords alike.
The weeks of June and July were tense.

notes: Near misses keep 'and' and 'or' between nouns or verbs. Top examples also include ', or perhaps' and a few other tokens.
